test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following received the National Florence Nightingale Award 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SV Saraswati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** National Florence Nightingale Award** ​:

 
 
• National Florence Nightingale Award is the** highest national distinction a nurse can achieve for selfless devotion and exceptional professionalism**.
 
• In a virtual former **President Ram Nath Kovind** conferred the** National Florence Nightingale Award 2020** on** Deputy Director General of Military Nursing Service (MNS) Brig. S.V. Saraswati **for her immense contribution to the MNS as a nurse administrator.
 
• She is from the** Chittoor district of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• She has conducted various outreach activities for the troops and has** trained** more than** 1,000 soldiers and families** in basic life support.
 
• Saraswati has served at various **pan-India Army hospitals** and **United Nations Peace Keeping Forces in Congo**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0abcfe0fc2d6229d2b3d168f3bb713e3e4eaeb7ca0ac07085646d2e6a9ae4574.png] 

 
• SV Saraswati

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Sara Rai**:

 
 
• Sara Rai is a contemporary** Indian writer, editor of anthologies and translator of modern Hindi and Urdu fiction**. 
 
 
 
• **Shahnaz Habib**:
 
 
• Shahnaz Habib is an Indian **essayist, fiction writer, travel writer, and translator based in the United States of America**.
 
• She received the** JCB Prize for Literature in 2018**.
